basePrompt:
Redraw the attached reference as a single 2D hand-painted inventory icon for a Star Wars RPG. Subject: <SUBJECT>.

Match the reference's silhouette, proportions, viewing angle and parts exactly; only change the rendering style. Style: clean 2D digital painting like a classic RPG item icon, bold readable silhouette, crisp edges, simple cel-style shading with 3 to 4 tones per region, a soft highlight on the upper left. It must read clearly when shrunk to 64x64 pixels.

Color rule (strict): every region in the reference is a flat key color. Paint each region using only lighter and darker shades of its own key color: red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, violet or magenta. Keep each region's boundaries where they are in the reference. Do not add any other colors. Do not use white, gray, black, metallic sheen, rim lights or glows. Outlines and deepest shadows are the darkest shade of that region's own color, not black.

Composition: one helmet only, centered, filling about 90% of a square canvas, nothing cropped. Plain flat #808080 gray background (or transparent). No frame, border, text, logo, shadow on the ground or watermark. Square 1024x1024 output.
reference: Each request attached a render of helm_<ID>.mdl recolored by tint-map layer into the key colors below. The generated source images are not kept in the repository.
postprocess: python tools/ConvertKeyedHelmetIcons.py --source <folder of ihelm_<ID>.png images> (run from the SWLOR_NWN root) writes SWLOR_Haks/sw_pt_helm/ihelm_<ID>.plt
